user_reaction_and_satisfaction: The User was driving the interaction forward with high-level pedagogical enforcement, unsatisfied until the AI proved it understood the meta-cognitive layer of the interaction.
did_ai_actually_understand: Initially, the AI only updated the rules. Upon the User's prompting, the AI realized it missed the meta-narrative. The AI then created DT-006 to immortalize the User's cognitive thought process.
was_work_done_exactly_as_asked: Yes. The AI formulated new cards specifically detailing the User's thought process, flaw-detection methodology, and Socratic guidance style.
evolutionary_takeaways: Sophron must not only record WHAT rules the User sets, but HOW the User thinks about systems, WHY they identify flaws, and HOW they guide the AI to deeper realizations.
